source.work: pstack principles (boundary, domain, reader load, idempotency, legacy deletion, proof)
source.paraphrase: A test that would still pass when the code returns undefined is not asserting the behavior the caller observes. Assert a literal expected value.

invariants.why: Those matchers pass when the value is merely present or the function was merely called. A wrong total, a wrong argument, and undefined-returning fakes still go green.
invariants.fixHint: Assert the literal the caller should observe, or toHaveBeenCalledWith the arguments that matter.
invariants.avoid: toHaveBeenCalledWith is not this list. A bracket call such as expect(x)["toBeDefined"]() is a hole. The rule only sees test files.

source.work: pstack principles (boundary, domain, reader load, idempotency, legacy deletion, proof)
source.paraphrase: Before calling the work done, check the real result. A test that does not assert a value is a self-report that the function ran.

invariants.why: A test that never asserts stays green when the behavior is wrong. Running a function is not a proof of what it returned.
invariants.fixHint: Assert the value the caller observes, with expect(...) or assert.equal(...).
invariants.avoid: it.each and test.skip are not exactly the names it and test, so they are holes. A local named expect that is never called does not count. Core's assertion ratchet covers a drop in assertion count across a diff; this rule covers a test that has none.

source.work: One Hundred Invariant Rules for the Software Engineer–Architect
source.paraphrase: A test case reads as a linear arrange, act, assert story without selecting a result through its own branches.

invariants.why: When the test chooses the expected result based on the same condition as production code, it can mirror the bug instead of detecting it.
invariants.fixHint: Split concrete cases and assert a literal result in each. Review intentional branches in property-based tests.
invariants.avoid: Only if, switch, and ternary expressions inside direct test/it calls in test files are matched; helper control flow is out of scope.
